::: {.aims}
::: {}
### Publications
SASA publishes the South African Statistical Journal and the Conference Proceedings.
:::

::: {}
### Education and development
SASA gives financial support for study, research and teaching through bursaries, scholarships and awards.
:::

::: {}
### Webinars and seminars
SASA runs a webinar and seminar programme with local universities.
:::
:::
